answer: Trace the provenance of each identity's entry funding: follow the on-chain path its stake took and flag identities whose funds spring from one common source or hop through one karst of shared wallets. Honest agents fund themselves from scattered, unrelated origins, each a separate opal. A farm must capitalize a thousand heads, and that money almost always traces back to one treasury however it is split and relayed; the branching payout tree from a single root is the tell. Timing can be disguised, but the pearl-string of funding back to one purse exposes a thousand heads from one hand.
